name: Metaplanet
email_summary: No new BTC purchase disclosed this week; MSCI exclusion risk is the dominant near-term overhang.
bottom_line: Metaplanet had no fresh weekly Bitcoin purchase disclosure in this 8-day window, leaving the accumulation pace opaque, while the pending MSCI 'non-operating company' index screen threatens forced passive-fund outflows if finalized in the November review. Rising Japanese superlong bond yields are also cited as a headwind to the funding environment for future BTC purchases.
price_impact: Likely down/mixed on index-exclusion overhang and financing-cost concerns; a lack of confirmed new purchases this week removes a typical positive catalyst.

updates.headline: MSCI weighs excluding Metaplanet from global indexes
updates.what_happened: MSCI's consultation on a new 'non-operating company' screen, which flagged Metaplanet based on May 2026 balance-sheet data, remains open for feedback through September 30 with a decision due by October 16. If adopted, changes would take effect in the November 2026 index review, with estimates of up to roughly $2 billion in combined forced passive outflows for Strategy and Metaplanet.
updates.thesis_fit: Loss of index eligibility would reduce passive-fund demand for shares, a governance/market-structure risk that is independent of BTC-per-share execution.
updates.price_impact: Likely down if the exclusion is finalized; near-term effect is speculative positioning and hedging ahead of the Oct 16 decision.
